subject.title: feat: adopt shared design system across ClawHub UI

question: Should this design-system migration remain blocked until the private design-system dependency is installable by CI/Vercel and the stacked draft prerequisites are ready?
rationale: The source shape looks coherent, but the remaining blockers are maintainer-owned release and automation choices rather than a narrow code repair.

options.title: Hold for stack and automation access
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge until the base stack is ready, hosted checks can install the design-system package, and accessible proof is attached.

options.title: Publish or credential the dependency first
options.body: Make the design-system package readable to CI/Vercel or wire narrowly scoped credentials before reconsidering this PR.

options.title: Accept local-only validation
options.body: A maintainer could intentionally merge with local validation only, but that would own the CI, preview, and proof visibility risk.

recommendation.title: Hold for stack and automation access
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge until the base stack is ready, hosted checks can install the design-system package, and accessible proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen owns the visible design-system stack and has the clearest current-main history on the affected UI shell.
